note: Each bar is normalised to 100%, so segments are each employer's share of that row's role-holders; the dashed line marks 50%. Rows are ordered most-concentrated first. The six largest employers get their own colour; smaller ones pool into 'Other orgs'. The data view shows the underlying counts.
methodology: Same construction over each repository's committers, so only repos that grant committer appear.
Compare a repo's two bars: a single-colour maintainer bar beside a multi-colour committer bar is a concentrated top with a diverse bench underneath it.
population: People holding the committer role in each repository, by curated employer; a person is counted in every repository where they hold it.
